slides.title: Ready when handed out
slides.html: A phone your MDM sets up reaches its user ready: apps installed, and Deploy App opens under the phone's own callsign.

slides.title: By hand, one phone at a time
slides.html: Without MDM each user opens an invite, waits for an admin to approve them, downloads a key and installs it with a password. Thirty phones, thirty times.

slides.title: With MDM, a whole batch
slides.html: Set it up once, and every phone you enrol gets its apps and the Deploy App icon by itself, and its certificate once you name it. Nobody types an invite code.

slides.title: The key stays on the phone
slides.html: Each phone makes its own key and Deploy App signs it. No key file and no password is passed around.

slides.title: How it works
slides.html: Your MDM sets up the phone. Deploy App gives it an identity: a certificate in its callsign.

slides.title: One callsign per phone
slides.html: Each phone joins as its callsign, such as OTTER4, and reaches Deploy App and its services like any user.

slides.title: Enrol first, name after
slides.html: Phones enrol in any number and any order. Once they all have their apps, name them at once: each then gets its certificate.

slides.title: You decide when
slides.html: Phones can join your MDM at any time, but Deploy App issues certificates only while enrolment is open, at most 2 hours. Every opening makes a new challenge: a password your MDM needs.

slides.title: What your MDM must do
slides.html: Your MDM must be able to do these five things. Using another MDM shows each one.

slides.title: Fleet works as it comes
slides.html: Fleet (FleetDM) is one MDM, and the one that works as it comes: the ODMDM connector sets it up for you. Another MDM needs a plugin for the connector, none yet, or its settings made by hand.

slides.title: What you need
slides.html: An MDM with Android Enterprise turned on (ask whoever runs it), and a group in it for this Deploy App's phones. The ODMDM connector is optional: without it, see Without the connector in Connect your MDM.

slides.title: Your route
slides.html: Install the connector, connect your MDM, enrol the phones, name them and start them. With Fleet, first check What Fleet needs in Set Fleet up for Deploy App; with another MDM, start at Using another MDM.
